posts.title: For Gloom The Bell Tolls
posts.description: a kooky, gloomy D&D one-shot adventure on an island of fish For Gloom The Bell Tolls is a whimsical D&D one-shot mystery adventure about an island of fish-people plagued by a mysterious illness. Written by Jon Baker and myself in 2018. It is quite simple and linear, but I've run it at least eight times, and each time has been a blast. You can read the adventure here . posts.title: Grand Budapest Kinetic Typography (2016)
posts.description: "If this do be the end, farewell!" cried the wounded piper boy. A kinetic typography piece I made for a class back in 2016, set to the climactic scene of Wes Anderson's The Grand Budapest Hotel . My original file is long gone, so this is a copy rescued from an old Facebook post and uploaded to the Internet Archive .

posts.title: Tales from the Juniper Tree
posts.description: fragments of a fairy tale, told through objects around a tree Tales from the Juniper Tree is an non-linear, interactive webcomic I made back in 2017 for a class on interactive art. It started out on the college's student web server and, like most things hosted on a class web server, it was bound to be deleted. So I've given it a new home. It starts with a tree and the things caught in and around it: an apple, a bird, a ring, a scarf, a pair of shoes, a chest, and a grave. Each will bring you to something... strange? Soft? Solemn? Then you return to the tree and pick another one. Read it here →
